name: Harima Chemicals Group, Inc.
summary: Harima Chemicals Group, Inc. primarily manufactures and sells various chemicals in Japan, China, Asia, South and North America, Europe, and internationally. The company operates through Resins and Chemicals products business, Papermaking Chemicals, Electronic Materials segments. The Resins and Chemicals products segment offers resins for paints, resins for printing inks, emulsifiers for synthetic rubber, resins for adhesives, and tall oil products. The Papermaking Chemicals segment provides paper strength enhancers, sizing agents, coating agents, and barrier coating agents.
